mapper.sql: sv.id, sv.workspace_id, sv.user_id, sv.record_type, sv.name, sv.config_json, sv.visibility, sv.position, CASE WHEN sv.user_id = #{userId} THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS owned_by_current_user, CASE WHEN pin.saved_view_id IS NULL THEN FALSE ELSE TRUE END AS pinned, pin.position AS pin_position, CASE WHEN def.saved_view_id IS NULL THEN FALSE ELSE TRUE END AS is_default, sv.created_at, sv.updated_at

LEFT JOIN saved_view_pin pin ON pin.workspace_id = sv.workspace_id AND pin.user_id = #{userId} AND pin.saved_view_id = sv.id LEFT JOIN saved_view_default def ON def.workspace_id = sv.workspace_id AND def.user_id = #{userId} AND def.record_type = sv.record_type AND def.saved_view_id = sv.id
sv.id, sv.workspace_id, sv.user_id, sv.record_type, sv.name, sv.config_json, sv.visibility, sv.position, sv.created_at, sv.updated_at
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM saved_view sv
WHERE sv.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND sv.record_type = #{recordType} AND (sv.user_id = #{userId} OR sv.visibility = 'workspace') ORDER BY CASE WHEN sv.user_id = #{userId} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, CASE WHEN sv.user_id = #{userId} THEN 0 ELSE sv.user_id END, sv.position, sv.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO saved_view (workspace_id, user_id, record_type, name, config_json, visibility, position) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{userId}, #{recordType}, #{name}, #{config,typeHandler=ooo.klae.connex.backend.mappers.JsonNodeTypeHandler}, #{visibility}, #{position})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM saved_view WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND id = #{id}
DELETE FROM saved_view WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND user_id = #{userId}
